description: Bench run plan extracted from a protocol document.

title.description: Document title (first heading), verbatim. Empty when none.

short_title.description: At most 4 words taken from the title, for people to say (e.g. 'Drug A/B Dosing'). Empty when there is no title.

liquids.description: Reagents and solutions named by the document.

name.description: Liquid name as stated, e.g. Drug A 10 uM working solution.

concentration.description: Stated concentration with unit (10 uM), or null.

quote.description: Verbatim document sentence this liquid comes from.

conditions.description: Experimental conditions (array form: strict mode forbids free-key maps).

label.description: Condition name as stated, e.g. Drug A.

treatments.description: Liquid ids applied to this condition.

replicates.description: Replicate count, or null when the document does not state one.

wells.description: Plate positions as WellRef strings (B2, B2-B8) ONLY when the document states them, else null. Never invent positions.

quote.description: Verbatim document sentence this condition comes from.
Verbatim document sentence this step comes from.

minutes.description: Duration in minutes when stated, else null. Never invent numbers.

temp_c.description: Temperature in Celsius when stated, else null.

caution.description: Verbatim caution sentence (do not..., Tip:/Note:/Caution: markers), or null. Never write tips: there is no tip field.

pipette.description: Transfer detail for pipetting steps, else null.

volume.description: Volume when stated, else null. Never invent numbers.

unit.description: Volume unit as stated (ul, ml), else null.

type.description: wells: stated positions; condition: one condition; all_used: every used well; other: anything else.

value.description: WellRef string for wells, condition id for condition, else null.

repeat.description: Repeat count 1-12 when stated (wash x2), else null.
